title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of Judicial Interpretation No. 28 [1996]

articles.content_en:
Higher People's Court of Shandong Province:
We have received your Request for Instructions on How to Apply Document Fa Fa [1996] No. 28 of the Supreme People's Court to Determine the Place of Performance of a Purchase and Sale Contract. Upon deliberation, we reply as follows:
Document Fa Fa [1996] No. 28 of the Supreme People's Court, namely the Provisions on How to Determine the Place of Performance of a Purchase and Sale Contract in the Jurisdiction of Economic Dispute Cases, is a procedural provision concerning the jurisdiction of cases by the People's Courts. Regardless of whether a purchase and sale contract is signed before or after the said Provisions take effect, any purchase and sale contract dispute case that is brought to a People's Court after the said Provisions take effect shall be governed by the said Provisions, and Article 19 of the Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China shall no longer apply.
It is hereby replied.
